integrity: Mathematical proof and independently implemented finite-field checks supplied. Prior structural derivation formulas are credited. Finite computations are not used as infinite proofs. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the standard \((n+1)\)-dimensional filiform Lie algebra for \(n\ge3\) over finite fields. A more general uninspected source might subsume the enumeration.
title: Idempotent derivation rank spectra of model filiform Lie algebras over finite fields
